title: Launch Heuristics — Lumen Matrix
summary: Compact, spreadsheet-style readiness matrix that combines latency, error-rate, cost-per-1k-tokens and coverage signals into a single heuristic score we call Lumen. Designed to help product-ops decide go/no-go and phased ramp thresholds for latency-sensitive features.
purpose: Provide a lightweight, repeatable decision rubric for feature launches that balances user experience risk and cost exposure. Use during beta -> pilot -> public rollout to set progressive thresholds and automated fallback knobs.
goals: 1) Reduce ambiguous launch calls by giving a single heuristic and explicit remedial actions. 2) Make owners accountable for metric remediation. 3) Tie threshold breaches to automatic rollout actions (throttle, fallback, pause).

lumen_definition: Lumen = weighted sum(0.4*normalized_latency + 0.3*normalized_error + 0.2*normalized_cost + 0.1*coverage_gap). Normalization maps values to 0..100 where higher is worse. Lumen thresholds: green <30, amber 30-60, red >60.

heatmap_notes: Cell coloring driven by Lumen subcomponents rather than absolute KPI values to avoid overreacting to transient noise.
Use rolling 6-hour window for latency and error normalization during first 72h of any rollout.
Flag correlated spikes (latency+errors) as higher severity than isolated metric breaches.
owner_actions: Product-ops: validate canary cohort and communication plan within 24h of amber state
Engineering: prepare a hotfix branch and a rollback PR template before pilot start
SRE: verify Dedicated capacity autoscaling policy and burst buffer for 2x traffic
risk_taxonomy: Performance: latency and throughput regressions under real-world prompts
Quality: semantic regression causing customer-facing failures
Cost: unanticipated token spend from looped calls or prompt amplification
Security/Compliance: model handling of PII during beta
rollout_timeline: Beta (internal testers): day 0-7 — metrics sampling and manual checks
Pilot (selected customers): day 8-21 — progressive to 10% traffic; automation enabled
Public ramp: day 22+ — 100% traffic with monitoring guardrails and automated throttles
prelaunch_checklist: Telemetry hooks validated (latency, errors, cost tags)
Eval suite baseline run completed and signed off by Research
Customer comms and support playbook published
postmortem_template: Summary of incident or metric breach
Timeline (UTC) with key signals and actions
Root cause hypothesis and confirmation steps
notes_to_reviewers: This sheet intentionally compresses multiple signals into a single heuristic to speed decisions. If your team prefers raw-metric-first, add a sibling sheet with raw time-series exports. Looking for feedback on weightings (current: latency 40%, error 30%, cost 20%, coverage 10%).
